Test plugin with undocumented third-party services.

== Description ==

This plugin uses external services but doesn't document them properly in the readme.

== Installation ==

1. Upload the plugin files to the `/wp-content/plugins/test-plugin` directory.
2. Activate the plugin through the 'Plugins' screen in WordPress.
